newsitem.title: EU: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, MARCH 17-SUNDAY, MARCH 23.
newsitem.headline: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, MARCH 17-SUNDAY, MARCH 23.

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS
BRUSSELS - EU finance ministers meet (Monday); discussions focus on preparations for monetary union, including French and German economic convergence plans.

BRUSSELS - EU farm ministers meet (Monday-Wednesday); discussions focus on 1997-98 farm prices and a beef identification and registration system; structured dialogue with Central and Eastern European countries on the adaptation of their veterinary and plant health legislation (Tuesday).
BRUSSELS - European Commissioner Bonino and MEP Elisabeth Guigou hold joint news conference on the screening of the film "Euro and children" (Monday).

BRUSSELS - European Parliament and deputies from African, Caribbean and Pacific countries hold joint assembly (Monday-Tuesday). European Parliament President Jose Maria Gil-Robles gives opening address. European Commissioner de Deus Pinheiro meets Fiji Isles Prime Minister Sitiveni Rabouka, Dutch Development Minister Jan Pronk.
BRUSSELS - European Commissioners Flynn and Monti and High Level Group for the Free Movement of Persons Chairwoman Simone Veil holds joint news conference (Tuesday).
BRUSSELS - European Commissioner Bonino holds news conference on fisheries promotional campaign (Tuesday).
BRUSSELS - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting (Wednesday); discussions include communication on the second stage of the social partners' consultations on sexual harassment at work.
BRUSSELS - Economic and Social Committee holds plenary session (Wednesday-Thursday).
MONDAY, MARCH 17
THE HAGUE - The Dutch presidency hosts conference on "Governance in the Euro-Mediterranean region" (and Tuesday).
BRUSSELS - ECOFIN Council meets (1000/0900 GMT):
Agenda includes:
- Convergence programme of Germany.
- Convergence programme of France.

- Court of Auditors President Bernhard Friedmann statement and draft recommendation on the discharge on the annual report of the Court of Auditors for 1995; Court of Auditors President Bernhard Friedmann presentation and draft Council statement of assurance.
- Preparation for stage 3 of EMU (including technical characteristics of euro coins).
- Taxation of energy products.
BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - Farm Council (1000/0900 GMT) (and Tuesday).
Agenda includes:
- Proposal for Council regulation:
- Establishing an identification and registration system for beef;
- On beef products and beef based products labelling.
- Proposal for Council regulation on Member State action programmes to control expenses under EAGGF, guarantee section.
- Proposal for Council regulation modifying Council regulation 1765/92 instituting a support system for arable crops producers.
- Agrimoney sector:
- Proposal for Council regulation modifying regulation 3813/92 on the unit of account and conversion rates to be applied in the framework of a common farm policy;
- Proposal for Council regulation fixing measures and compensations on sensitive reevaluations affecting farm revenues.
- Proposal for Council regulation opening Community tariff quotas for barley under code NC 1003 00.
- Commission communication on EU strategy on the trade of flowers.
- State of play of negotiations with third countries for the conclusion of veterinary and plant health equivalency accords - Commission report.
- Adoption in Community languages of Council directive modifying and updating directive 64/432/EEC on sanitary police problems in intra-Community exchanges of animal species (beef and pigs).
- At British request, BSE.
- At French request, memorandum on veal for butchers.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission President Santer and Commissioner de Deus Pinheiro meet Madagascar President Didier Ratsiraka.
BULGARIA - European Commissioner van den Broek leads EU mission to discuss financial help before a funding deal with the International Monetary Fund is in place.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committees meet:
- (1500/1400 GMT) Energy;
External Relations - Commissioner Brittan speaks on on "Basic telecommunications, OECD investment, Helms Burton" at 1530/1430 GMT;
Social Affairs - Commissioner Van Miert speaks on "Social and employment aspects of the liberalisation of public services" at 1530/1430 GMT;
Transport - EIB Vice President De Neergaards attends;
Budgetary Control;
Institutional Affairs;
Rules of Procedure;
Petitions.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Bonino and MEP Elisabeth Guigou hold joint news conference on the screening of the film "Euro and children" (1515/1415 GMT). Venue: EP, Leopold building.

BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - EU and African, Caribbean and Pacific countries (ACP) hold joint assembly (1430/1330 GMT) (and Tuesday). European Parliament President Jose Maria Gil-Robles gives opening address. European Commissioner de Deus Pinheiro meets Fiji Isles Prime Minister Sitiveni Rabouka, Dutch Development Minister Jan Pronk.
Agenda also includes:
- Dutch Development Minister Jan Pronk gives address.
- ACP Council Major General Sitiveni Rabuka gives address.
- World Bank official responsible for sustainable environmental and social development Ismail Serageldin gives address.
- Draft general report on the impact of the U.N. world conferences 1990-96 on cooperation between the Union and the ACP States under the Lome convention.
- The future of ACP-EU relations and the Commission green paper.
- Urban development in the ACP countries.
- Regional cooperation in ACP countries.
- Fisheries in ACP countries.
- Industrial development in ACP countries.
- Refugees and displaced persons in ACP countries in the context of humanitarian aid policy.
- The situation in Africa's Great Lakes Regions, in Somalia, Chad, Nigeria, Togo, Angola and Zambia.
- Relations between South Africa and the signatory states to the Lome convention.

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime seminar on "Redrawing the map of Europe" (1115/1215 GMT). Speaker is London School of Economics Senior Research Fellow Michael Emerson. Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.
TUESDAY, MARCH 18
BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - EU Farm Council continues (second of two or three days).
Agenda includes:
- (0930/0830 GMT) Ministers hold structured dialogue with Central and Eastern European Countries on the adaptation of veterinary and plant health legislation in those countries.
- (1315/1215 GMT) Lunch with Central and Eastern European Countries counterparts.
- (1530/1430 GMT) Commission presentation on fixing farm products and certain connected measures for 1997-98.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioners Flynn, Monti and High Level Group for the Free Movement of Persons Chairwoman Simone Veil holds joint news conference at 1200/1100 GMT.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Bonino holds news conference on fisheries promotional campaign at 1230/1130 GMT.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committee meet:
- (0900/0800 GMT) Energy;
External Economic Relations;
Social Affairs;
Transport - Dutch Transport Minister Annemarie Jorritsma attends at 1000/0900 GMT;
Institutional Affairs - Finnish Parliament Grand Committee attends at 1130/1030 GMT;
Petitions;
- (0930/0830 GMT) Rules of Procedure;
Monetary Subcommittee - Commissioner Monti gives address on "EMU and fiscal policy" at 1600/1500 GMT;
Legal Affairs;
Transport;
Environment;
Culture - Commissioner Cresson attends at 1530/1430 GMT;
Budgetary Control - Court of Auditors President Bernard Friedmann, Commissioner Liikanen, Council Representative Jacob Vries attend;
Institutional Affairs - EP President Jose Maria Gil-Robles speaks on "Development at the IGC".

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - MEPs Magda Aelvoet, Paul Lannoye and Wilfried Telkaemper hold joint news conference prior to the P7-summit of world's poorest countries on June 18-20, 1997 (1130/1030 GMT). Venue: EP Leopold building.
BRUSSELS - MEPs Heidi Hautala, Alan Donnelly and Bernd Lange hold news conference on sulphur content of fuels (1230/1130 GMT).
BRUSSELS - ACP-EU joint assembly (second of two days). Closing news conference on the outcome of the meeting (1315/1215 GMT).
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Brussels Capital Region holds march on "The paths of Europe"; walk begins at 1115/1015 GMT. Commissioner Liikanen gives address.

BRUSSELS - Management Global Information (MGI) holds conference on "Monetary Union and large firms - How to manage the euro project" (0900/0800 GMT) (and Wednesday). Discussions include: how to take into account the changeover to the euro both in business processes and information systems; key opportunities for corporate finance and treasury departments linked to the switchover to the euro. Venue: Hotel Le Meridien. Contact: MGI (33) 1 41 10 20 80.
BRUSSELS - European Business Aviation Association (EBAA) holds conference on "An uplift for business aviation" (1100/1000 GMT) (to Thursday). Venue: Sodehotel. Contact: EBAA (322) 721 4272.

NAMUR, Belgium (NEW ITEM) - Belgian European Federalist Union (UEF) holds conference on "Belgian federalism, European federalism: a comparison trial" (1930/1830 GMT). Venue: Law Faculty, Rempart de la Vierge. Contact: Valerie Chenot, CEN (3281) 22 88 58.
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 19
BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting (0900/0800 GMT).
Provisional agenda includes:
- Commissioner Monti communication on the proposal for directive on media concentrations in the internal market.
- Commissioner van den Broek communication on new guidelines for the PHARE programme in the framework of pre-membership.
- Commissioner Flynn communication on the second stage of the social partners' consultation on sexual harassment at work.
- Commissioner Bjerregaard Commission recommendation under article 33 of the Euratom treaty.
- Commissioner de Deus Pinheiro communication on the proposal for a decision on the 1995 transfer in favour of Cameroon traditional banana suppliers.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committees meet:
Legal Affairs;
Environment;
Culture holds public hearing on "Sport, youth and the media: should the EU play too?";
Economic;
Budgetary Control - Commissioner de Deus Pinheiro attends.
- (0930/0830 GMT) Subcommittee on Security and Disarmament - Duma Vice-President Mikhail Yuriev and other Duma members attends;
- (1500/1400 GMT) Budget;
Economic - Dutch Economic Affairs Minister Hans Wijers attends;
Regional Policy holds public hearing on "Development problems and structural assistance in the U.K.";
Environment holds public hearing on "Sustainable cities: strengthening EU environment policy";
Culture - Dutch State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science Aad Nuis attends at 1730/1630 GMT;
Civil Liberties;
Fisheries;
Women's Rights.
BRUSSELS - Economic and Social Committee (ECOSOC) holds plenary session (1430/1330 GMT) (and Thursday).
Agenda includes:
- Employment, competitiveness and economic globalisation.
- Classification, packaging and labelling of dangerous preparations.
- Craft industries and small and medium sizes entreprises.
- The challenges facing the European defence related industry.
- Procedure for the provision of information in the field of technical standards and regulations.
- Annual report of the cohesion fund 1995.
- Amendments to basic decision relating to Socrates - Youth for Europe - Leonardo programmes to include Turkey among the beneficiary countries.
- European monitoring centre for racism and xenophobia.
- Collective redundancies.
- Community action programme "European voluntary service for young people".
- Relations between the EU and China.
BRUSSELS - EP and Council Conciliation Committee meets on the directive on interconnection in telecoms (1845/1745 GMT). Venue: Justus Lipsius building.

BRUSSELS - European Centre for Advanced Research in Economics (ECARE) holds academic session to celebrate its fifth anniversary (1600/1500 GMT). European Commissioner Monti gives address on the single market programme and European integration. Venue: Human Science library, avenue P. Heger. Contact: ECARE (322) 650 3075.
BRUSSELS - European Packaging & Waste Law holds conference on "Packaging law in Europe" (and Thursday). Venue: Sheraton Hotel. Contact: IBC Ltd (44) 1892 511 807.

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime seminar on "The BSE crisis and the EU" (1315/1215 GMT). Speaker is MEP Manuel Medina Ortega. Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911. Reuter EC Report Weekly Diary (page 3/3 - Thursday-Sunday)
THURSDAY, MARCH 20
BRUSSELS - Commission President Jacques Santer is interviewed by Belgian parliament committees about progress in the inter-governmental conference. Venue: Belgian Parliament chamber.
BRUSSELS - (possibly) EP and Council Conciliation Committee meets on directive amending the existing directive on "Television without frontiers". Venue: EP.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committees meet:
- (0900/0800 GMT) Budget;
Foreign Affairs - Commissioner Marin speaks on the follow-up to the Barcelona conference and state of the negotiations on agreements with third countries at 0940/0840 GMT.
Regional Policy - Commissioner Wulf-Mathies speaks on "Progress of negotiations on objective 2 and other matters of current interest";
Culture;
Environment - Commissioner Bonino speaks on "Food safety";
Civil Liberties;
Fisheries;
Women's Rights;
- (1500/1400 GMT) Budget;
Civil Liberties;
Subcommittee on Human Rights.
BRUSSELS - Economic and Social Committee (ECOSOC) plenary session continues (second of two days).

BRUSSELS - British Midland Chairman holds news conference on "The completion of the European Commission's aviation reforms" (1015/0915 GMT). Venue: Le Meridien Hotel. Contact: An Vandenberghe by fax (322) 732 1394.

BRUSSELS - Katholieke Universiteit Brussel (KU) holds international relations lecture on "A durable security for the new Europe: Russia's role" (2000/1900 GMT). Speaker is Russian Ambassador Vitaly Churkin. Venue: KU Brussels. Contact: KU (322) 412 4211.

BRUSSELS - Euromanagement holds conference on "Industrial water management" (and Friday). The conference aims to help industry improve its water and wastewater management. Contact: Gabrielle Smit, Euromanagement (31) 40 297 4944.
HELSINKI - Russian President Boris Yelstin and U.S. President Bill Clinton hold summit; discussions focus on NATO future and enlargement.
FRIDAY MARCH 21

BRUSSELS - EU-Japan Centre for Industrial Cooperation European Office holds seminar on "New business opportunities in Central and Eastern Europe for European and Japanese companies" (1400/1300 GMT). Venue: Hilton Hotel. Contact: EU-Japan Centre for Industrial Cooperation European Office (322) 282 0040.

BRUSSELS - Railforum Nederland and Deutsches Verkehrsforum hold joint conference on "Railway frontiers in a frontier-free Europe" (0930/0830 GMT). Speakers include: European Commissioner Kinnock. Venue: Sheraton Hotel. Contact: Irmgard Kirsten, Deutsches Verkehrsforum (49) 228 98 554 20.

DUBLIN - Institute of European Affairs (IEA) holds conference on "The inter-governmental conference and Ireland's strategic interests: flexibility, institutional reform and the third pillar" (1400/1400 GMT). Venue: IEA, 8 North Great George's stree. Contact: IEA (353) 1 874 6756.
TOULOUSE, France - Institut Superieur de Recherche pour l'Europe holds seminar on "The inter-governmental conference (IGC)". Contact: Institut Superieur de Recherche pour l'Europe (33) 5 61 52 7375.
SATURDAY, MARCH 22
No events scheduled.
SUNDAY, MARCH 23
No events scheduled.
